status: retrospective protocol written after the SLB-1.3 test readout; prospective template for new donors
matching_scope: each retained pair appears in at least one line per ancestry group; complete-case sensitivity requires every line in a block
primary_metric: equal-block mean of equal-cell-line fitness-balanced AUROC
secondary_metric: equal-block mean of equal-cell-line precision at 10 measured pairs

inference.interval: Bonferroni-adjusted percentile interval; resample cell lines within ancestry, preserving repeated line appearances across blocks
